additional_info.body:
Dear Szymon,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / R2 170001476
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
MP / R2 170001476
Problem Description
: Requesting access to Router 2 for customer
Troubleshooting
:
As you may know, only a few selected people in our team have direct access to any router. It is a cybersecurity problem if we open this route to someone outside of Siemens, even if the router is for the customer. Having access to the router would mean access to the IP range not just the router.
The best we can provide you is everytime you need access to it, either you go on-site and connect to it or raise a ticket requesting support.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0388603
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
Please do not
change
the
subject of this Email when
replying
to it.
